$comment: MVP insect plates (design §6: observe · sketch · release). A field sketch (one portion) is recorded per observation tick, weighted by rarity; the pity timer lives in economy.json (observation). Nothing is taken — the insect is released; a completed plate (all portions sketched) is a book of rubbings granting a permanent multiplier. Plate lore lives in dialogue.json (insectPlates). habitats = zones with an observation site. A `rewarded` plate is the one exception to all of that: it is never drawn for, so it holds no habitats and no rarity, and it arrives already recorded when Play Games awards it (design §11). Its effect sits at the bottom of the band on purpose — the gift is that no one walked for it.
